finance.developer_share_status: Planning assumption; public Steam FAQ defers to the signed agreement, which was not inspected. No special high-revenue tier assumed.
finance.other_monthly_status: Editable allowance for agent/image/audio/storage/tools; not a quote, actual incremental cost or user budget. May replace existing subscriptions; enter allocated project cost consistently.
finance.fixed_other_status: Unallocated launch/admin/testing cash reserve, not a contractor/art/translation purchase or a legal/accounting quote. Charged at start as a conservative envelope.
finance.sales_basis: Equal volume stress cases, not genre forecasts or probabilities. Factors are hypothetical weighted averages, not measured mixes or local tax rates. Gross purchase counts before refunds; refunds deducted once.
finance.tail_note: No new buyers after first paid year in default comparison; deliberately no credit for later launches/tail sales without an input. Deferred episode conversion can occur later at completion and is labeled separately.
finance.withholding_status: Unknown user tax interview; 0 only computes pre-income-tax results. Optional effective fraction changes estimated bank receipts, not pre-tax earnings. No residence or treaty eligibility inferred.

license_reserve.status: Conservative trigger proxy: this game's trailing-year adjusted gross before store share. Actual Total Finances/revenue/funding and continued tool use determine eligibility. Other income unknown; current prices not guaranteed through multi-year production.
